ranking_comparison: Prospective comparison of absolute p_self with p_self(command) minus p_self(hold). Both patch/order choices are written before physics. Earlier nonstructural witnesses restrict eligibility when any are still untouched; otherwise all untouched patches are eligible. A paired body interval must exceed zero before advantage is preferred; any adoption also requires same-patch gains over controller, hold and exploration.
choice: Maximum predicted self-contact probability on an initially untouched patch. When a previously witnessed patch is untouched, restrict choice to those patches. Stable probability ties within 0.000001 prefer controller, hold, then exploratory candidates.
measurement: Same selected patch for all six commands; a new nonstructural self-contact onset within the next 50 ms, sampled every environment step. Structural pairs are ordinary neighbouring body contacts excluded from the contact reward. Raw patch contact is recorded separately. All branches start from the same complete snapshot and replay exactly.
acceptance: Selected-command onset rate exceeds controller, hold and mean exploration; paired 95% interval over eight body means excludes zero. Calibration starts do not enter acceptance.
limit: A one-step selection test; independent repeatability after further learning, retention, and transfer remain separate tests.
checkpoint_episode: episode companion restored (8 bodies saved; 8 caregiver recording tape(s) replaced by a plain list)
